current_date: Planning Application Requirements Local List September 2024; page footers 'Last updated September 2026'
current_evidence: The council's 'Make a planning application' page links 'Local list of planning application requirements' to this same document (10-planning-applications-local-list-of-requirements), its footers read 'Last updated September 2026', and a search found no newer or draft replacement list.

issues.detail: Householder row says '(none)', but several local list items apply to householder applications: Ecological Screening Assessment and BNG Screening Assessment (all applications except advertisement consent, lawful development certificates and non-material amendments); Heritage Statement (works affecting a listed building or its curtilage, in or adjacent to a conservation area, etc.); Tree Survey/Arboricultural Statement (trees on or adjacent to the site that could influence or be affected); Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zone 2 or 3 'including minor development'); CIL Question Form (over 100 sq m of new floorspace).
issues.evidence: Part 1 items 4 and 6: 'Required for all planning applications except for applications for:' advertisement consent, LDCs, non-material amendments; item 15: 'In flood zone 2 or 3 including minor development and change of use.'

issues.detail: Local list items that are not captured anywhere (no tab_item or app_type_row): 3 Amendments Proposed Form (non-material amendments s96A and minor material amendments s73); 4 Ecological Screening Assessment (all applications except adverts/LDC/NMA); 6 BNG Screening Assessment (same); 8 BNG Exemption Statement (where mandatory BNG does not apply); 9 Coal Mining Risk Assessment (all development in Development High Risk Areas, excluding the exemptions list); 14 Fire Statement (per DMPO 2015 as amended); 16b Broadband Connectivity Assessment (all major); 21 Noise Impact Assessment (noise-sensitive development near significant noise sources, or noisy development near housing); 22 Open Space Assessment (all major residential/mixed use creating open space need); 23 Planning Obligations (s106) Statement (all major); 26 Telecommunication Information (mast/antenna applications); 27 Town Centre Uses Impact Assessment (retail of 500 sq m+ outside Primary Shopping Areas; A2/A5 1,500 sq m+, leisure 2,500 sq m+, offices 10,000 sq m+ out of centre); 28 Transport Statement/Assessment (developments generating significant movement); 32 Relevant Application Information Template (application types specified periodically).
issues.evidence: Part 1 table of the Planning Application Requirements Local List September 2024 (items 1-32).

issues.detail: Most Full planning trigger excerpts are fragments from the Part 2 'what to include' descriptions, not the Part 1 'when required' triggers. Examples: Affordable Housing Statement gives 'proposed, the Affordable Housing Statement shall be accompanied by a full, un-redacted Viability Appraisal' when the trigger is 'Residential or mixed use development providing 10 or more dwellings'. Flood Risk Assessment gives 'or not a flood risk assessment is required.' when the trigger is Flood Zone 2/3 including minor development and change of use. Drainage Strategy/SuDS gives non-mains foul drainage text when the trigger is 'All Major applications'. Contaminated Land gives an LCRM guidance citation when the trigger is major applications with a sensitive end use or possible contamination. Statement of Community Involvement gives formatting text when the trigger is 'All major development'. Ventilation/Extraction gives 'measures and odour abatement techniques.' when the trigger is all applications installing cooked-food extraction, excluding dwellings. Energy/Sustainability gives a policy paragraph when the trigger is all new residential, mixed use, commercial, retail, community or leisure uses, with exceptions. Travel Plan gives monitoring text when the trigger is developments generating significant movement. Landscaping gives 'when submitting landscaping schemes.'
issues.evidence: Part 1 item 1: 'Residential or mixed use development providing 10 or more dwellings'; item 25: 'All Major applications'; item 31: 'All applications where extraction equipment for the preparation of cooked food is to be installed'.

issues.detail: Several rows carry text that belongs to a different requirement or is merged across table columns. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' contains Arboricultural Method Statement text. 'Block plan / Site plan' contains BNG GIS template text. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' contains the Coal Mining Risk Assessment and CIL Question Form text. 'Biodiversity Net Gain' is scrambled across columns ('a correctly th applications of major developments from the 12 February completed BNG Screening Assessment...'). 'Air Quality Assessment' starts mid-sentence ('residential units ...'). Heritage Statement gives only the conservation-area clause and omits listed buildings and curtilage, LBC, demolition in conservation areas, registered parks and gardens, ancient monuments and HER-recorded assets.
issues.evidence: Part 1 item 17 Heritage Statement: 'Applications for planning permission affecting a nationally or locally listed building or its curtilage' plus six further triggers.

issues.detail: About 29 requirements are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', although Part 1 has an application-type column for each item. Many apply equally to outline and reserved matters (e.g. Affordable Housing Statement, Community Involvement Statement, Open Space Assessment, SuDS for all majors). Other app types are wrongly given '(none)': Listed building consent (Heritage Statement is required for all LBC applications), Demolition in conservation area (Heritage Statement required), Non-material amendment and Variation of condition s73 (Amendments Proposed Form required). The two Outline rows ('Cycle parking details', 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)') come from site-plan drawing guidance, not outline-specific requirements.
issues.evidence: Part 1 item 3: 'Required for applicants seeking non-material amendments' (and s73 minor material amendments); item 17 covers listed building consent and demolition in conservation areas.

issues.detail: Some Full planning rows are not local list items. Daylight/Sunlight Assessment is only something the council 'may' request. Roof plan, Street scene/contextual drawings, Floor plans/elevations, Existing and proposed site levels and Housing mix/NDSS floor areas come from the Part 3 plans and drawings guidance (marked 'required in some cases'), not the Part 1 supporting documents list.
issues.evidence: Closing note: 'it may be necessary to request a Geotechnical Survey and design or a Daylight/Sunlight Assessment'; Part 3 contents: 'Roof plans - required in some cases'.

issues.detail: Several tab_items are fragments, link text or boilerplate: 'Heritage Guidance document (pdf, 5.26 MB) for help in producing these statements.' (link caption); 'For example overly faint lines and annotations that can't be viewed clearly will not be accepted.' (sentence fragment); 'Each plan/drawing should have a title box stating: ... the drawing number, e.g.' (cut off); 'Copies of applications sent on a compact disc will not normally be accepted - except for applications submitted to Bristol City Council.' (self-contradictory, garbled); 'Maps may also be provided as a shapefile' (optional, not a requirement).
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing / document standards' sections.

issues.detail: Several rows reuse the same excerpt for different requirements: Affordable Housing Statement and Viability Assessment (both the un-redacted Viability Appraisal sentence), Drainage Strategy/SuDS and Foul Sewage/Utilities (both the non-mains foul drainage sentence), and Advertisement drawings and Lighting Assessment (both the advert luminance sentence).

List date 2026-09-01 comes from the 'Last updated September 2026' footer. The document's own title edition is 'Local List September 2024' (with an addendum item 'Updated June 2025'), so the workbook should note both the edition and the update date.
issues.evidence: Title: 'Planning Application Requirements Local List September 2024'; footers: 'Last updated September 2026'.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Bristol local list (Sept 2024 edition, last updated Sept 2026). The extraction is poor: about 14 of the 32 Part 1 items are missing, Householder/LBC/NMA/s73 are wrongly shown as having no local requirements, and most triggers are Part 2 description fragments or mislabelled text rather than the actual thresholds.
